hooks.command: mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/workflows" 2>/dev/null; for w in op-enrichment op-plan-judge op-architect-judge op-run-judge-clustering op-explore-render; do rm -f "$HOME/.claude/workflows/$w.js"; done; cp -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/workflows/"op-*.js "$HOME/.claude/workflows/" 2>/dev/null; exit 0

if [ -n "$HOME" ] && [ -d "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/_shared" ]; then rm -rf "$HOME/.claude/skills/_shared" 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills/_shared" 2>/dev/null; cp -rf "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/_shared/." "$HOME/.claude/skills/_shared/" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
